chapter.verse: Tua hileh i Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris ii hong hehpihna dung zui-in note' sungah i Topa Jesu' min kipahtawi ding a, ama' sungah note hong kipahtawi ding hi.
Tu-in sanggamte aw, i Topa Jesu Khris' hong pai ding thu leh eite ama' kiangah hong kikaihkhop ding thu tawh kisai-in kong thum uh hi.
Topa ni hong tung khinta ci-in kha khatpeuh, thu kigen khatpeuh, ahihkeileh ko' kiangpan a kici laikhak khatpeuh hangin lungsim buai-in na patau pah kei un.
Bangci nam hitaleh kuamah' khemin om peuhmah kei un. A hang pen thu-up lampialna hong om masak mateng, kisiatna tapa ahi thukhun pampaihna a sem mipa hong kilat matengin tua ni hong tung lo ding hi.
Tua kisiatna tapa in pasian a kici peuhmah leh a kibia peuhmah langpangin tuate' tungah amahmah kisangkhan a, Pasian' biakinnpi sungah tusukin amahmah Pasian ci-in kipulak hi.
Note' kiangah kong om lai-in hih thute kong gen lam phawk lo na hi uh hiam?
Ama' hun a tun ciang bekin hong kilatkhiat theih nadingin tu laitakin amah a khaktan om ahihlam na theih uh ahi hi.
A hang pen thukhun pampaihna thu a simthamin gamtang khinta hi. Himah taleh tu-a a khaktan thu a kilakkhiat mateng bek a tuaci ding ahi hi.

A kilakkhiat ciangin thukhun pampaihna a sem mi hong kilaakkhia ding hi. Ahih hangin Topa Jesu in a kam pana pusuak a hu tawh tua mi mutlum ding a, ama' hong paina vangtaang tawh tua mi bangmahlo suaksak ding hi.
Tua thukhun pampaihmi hong pai ciangin Satan' gamtatzia nam ahi, nalamdang a namkim leh kihilna lim lamdang a maanlote tawh hong kuan ding a,
siatna a tuak ding mite zuau thu a namkim tawh khemin zol ding hi. Tua mite pen thumaan thutak a thupisim loh uh huhau-in hotkhiatna a ngah lohlawh uh ahi hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian in a maanlo thu a up nadingun tua mite' kiangah thuzuau vangliatna sawlkhia hi.
Tua pen thumaan thutak a um lo, diklohna thu ah a lungkim mite, a vekun thukhenna a ngah theih nading ahi hi.

Ahi zongin Topa' hong it sanggamte aw, Kha' hong siansuahna leh thumaan thutak upna tungtawnin hotkhiat a ngah dingin Pasian in a patcil pan note hong teel ahih manin note' hangin Pasian' tungah hehpihna a phat den ding ka hi uh hi.
Tua' adingin Pasian in ka tangkokhiat uh Lungdamna Thu tungtawnin note hong samkhia a, tua pen i Topa Jesu Khris' minpha na ngah theih nading uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, thugenna tawh ahi-a laikhak tawh ahi zongin note' tunga kong hilh uh zatngeizia thute' tungah dingkip unla tuate lenkip un.
Tu-in i Topa Jesu Khris mahmah in ahi zongin, eite hong itin hehpihna thu tungtawnin tawntung hehnepna leh lametna pha hong guan i Pa Pasian in ahi zongin,
